description: Represents a record of communication or activity, typically logged from email correspondence or other sources via the Gmail Addon.

endpoints.name: CreateInteraction
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record in the system, typically initiated from the Gmail Addon context.

model.description: The request body containing details for the new interaction, such as subject, participants, and related entities.

example_uses: Create a new interaction for an email conversation.
Log a new communication activity directly from a Gmail message.
Record an activity related to an email in the system, linking it to relevant contacts or partners.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to log a new interaction or communication event directly from the Gmail addon, capturing details about an email or other activity.

endpoints.name: UpdateInteraction
endpoints.description: Updates an existing interaction record in the system, typically initiated from the Gmail Addon context.

model.description: The request body containing the updated details for the interaction, including its identifier.

example_uses: Update the details of an existing interaction record.
Modify a previously logged email activity, such as adding notes or changing its status.
Change the status or notes of an interaction record that was created via the Gmail addon.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the details of an interaction that has already been recorded in the system, for example, to add follow-up notes or update its status.

endpoints.name: FindGmailInteraction
endpoints.description: Finds specific Gmail interactions based on provided criteria. This endpoint uses a POST request to allow for complex search criteria in the request body.

model.description: The request body containing the search criteria to find specific Gmail interactions, such as email IDs or subject keywords.

example_uses: Find an interaction associated with a specific Gmail message ID.
Search for interactions related to a particular email thread or conversation.
Retrieve interactions based on specific Gmail attributes or identifiers.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve existing interactions using specific search parameters provided in the request body, typically to find interactions linked to a particular email or Gmail context.

endpoints.name: FindRelatedRecords
endpoints.description: Finds records (e.g., contacts, partners, or other entities) related to a given Gmail context, such as an email address or message ID.

input.description: The request body containing information from the Gmail context (e.g., email addresses, message IDs) to find related records.

example_uses: Find contacts related to the current email sender or recipients.
Identify partners associated with an email conversation.
Retrieve any records linked to the email context to provide relevant information in the Gmail addon.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to discover other entities or records in the system that are related to the current email or Gmail context, such as finding existing contacts or partners.

endpoints.name: CreateRecordsFromEmails
endpoints.description: Creates new records in the system based on information extracted from emails, such as new contacts, interactions, or other relevant entities.

request.description: The request body containing the data extracted from emails to create new records, potentially including multiple record types.

example_uses: Generate new contact records from email signatures or content.
Create multiple interaction logs from a batch of emails.
Automate the creation of system records directly by processing information from email content.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to automatically create one or more new records (e.g., contacts, interactions, or other entities) in the system by processing information derived from emails.
